intro: Place a Village Hearth to found your village.
Build closed rooms and furnish them: beds, bookshelves, anvils and more.
Stand inside each room and use a Surveyor's Deed to register it.
Welcome the travellers who walk in from the road to your hearth.
Talk daily, give gifts, and share moments to grow friendships.
Offer a Bouquet, then a Promise Pendant, to start a life together.

description: The heart of every village. Placing a hearth founds a new village around it, and its warm glow draws wandering travellers in from the road.
Breaking the hearth dissolves the village, and its villagers pack up and leave.
usage: Place it somewhere central. Buildings must be within 96 blocks of it.
Two hearths need at least 64 blocks between them.
Right-click it to see the village's buildings and residents.

description: A surveyor's writ that reads a room. Stand inside a finished, sealed room and use the deed: it counts the furniture and registers the room as a Home, Library, Blacksmith or another building type.
Villagers only move in once a matching building exists.
usage: The room must be fully enclosed. If there is a gap, the deed tells you where.
Use it again after rearranging furniture to update the building.
If nothing matches, it names the closest building and what is missing.

description: A pocket journal that opens this very book wherever you are: villagers, friendships, homes, events and recipes, all in one place.
usage: You can also press the Hearthvale key (J by default) at any time, no item needed.

description: A hand-tied bunch of small flowers. In Hearthvale, it is how you ask someone if they would like to start courting.
usage: Right-click a romanceable villager while holding it.
They need to be at 8 hearts or more. Otherwise they decline, and you keep the bouquet.
Once accepted, you are dating and friendship can grow up to 10 hearts.

description: A golden pendant set with a ruby heart. It is a promise, and an invitation to spend your life with someone.
Offer it only to someone you are dating at 10 hearts.
usage: Right-click the villager you are dating while holding it.
If they say yes, the wedding takes place 3 days later near the hearth.
After the wedding your spouse moves into the home where your bed is, and friendship can grow up to 14 hearts.
